summary: The contract contains exactly 30 observable bit positions, so the accepted algorithm always performs one baseline API call followed by 30 singleton-mask calls.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 0 <= n <= 2^30 - 1, legal queries satisfy 0 <= num <= 2^30 - 1, and only the first 30 bits are compared

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted reference makes commonBits(0) once and then iterates over the fixed positions 0 through 29, issuing exactly one legal singleton-mask query per position.
Authored cases cover zero, the lowest and highest individual bits, the maximum value, consecutive bits, sparse boundary combinations, and both alternating 30-bit patterns.
